notes.title: Thanks for support! Here are the future update plans for "Esports Godfather"
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone, I’m 1000Water, the producer of "Esports Godfather."[/h3]


"Esports Godfather" has been released for over ten days now. During this period, we’ve received a lot of suggestions and feedback. My task list has quickly expanded, and I took some time last weekend to sort through it and make a plan.


From my perspective, the feedback and suggestions reveal different gameplay goals, which can be broadly divided into two parts. One group of coaches wants a more "managerial" experience, with better buying and selling, more detailed youth training, and more club-related development. The other group wants a better card-playing environment, with more rules, equipment, changes, and smarter AI.


Frankly, our update direction aligns with these goals. So, I’m here to reveal what we will be updating in the next few versions, which we plan to complete in 3-4 months.


[h2]1. Simulation Battles[/h2]
   
We’ve heard a lot of debates like "Niels is the best," "Gang forever," "Deep Space is too weak." This is what we want to see. Coaches can now upload their teams to the Steam Workshop and download other teams for battles.


[h2]2. Current League Performance Display[/h2]
 
From the information bar, you can view the current league standings, matches of other teams, kill rankings, your team’s information, and more. We plan to update this in two parts.


[h2]3. Hardcore Mode[/h2]
   
Real esports coaches face more complex player situations! Tailored coaching is the hallmark of a true esports godfather! We will add:
   
[h3]1. Player potential [which determines attribute growth bonuses]
2. Hero pool capacity limit [the maximum number of heroes each player can learn]
3. Professional affinity [different experience requirements for proficiency in various types of heroes][/h3]
   
These will be optional content in the custom options.


[h2]4. Playstyle Diversity[/h2]
  
A veteran player shouldn’t have just one playstyle! Advancing with a Gold Crown and retreating to an Isolated Island—that’s what makes a versatile player!Depending on a player’s innate abilities, they can have 1-2 additional sets of tactics-cards-skills. These unlock when the coach level and player abilities reach a certain threshold.


[h2]5. World Championship[/h2]
  
 We’ll keep the details of the World Championship under wraps until we are close to completion.


[h2]6. Coaching Staff[/h2]
  
 A mature club should have analysts, assistant coaches, scouts, etc. You’ll need to build your coaching team, which will provide various kinds of support.

   1. Assistant Coach
      
Assistant coaches will help with youth training, and we will revamp youth training to require training modules. Different assistant coaches will bring unique training modules.

   2. Analyst
      
Analysts will help with daily training research. Excess training sessions can be merged or redeveloped.
      
2.1 Merging: Each daily training session will have specific merging effects, enhancing the quality of training modules.
      
2.2 Redevelopment: Combining three low-level training modules will create a new high-level training module.

3. Scout

Want to find more promising youth players? Scouts will help. Depending on their abilities, they can find various talented youths for your youth academy.

4. Public Relations

A mature club needs good publicity. Different PR staff will have different strategies, boosting your team’s funding, coach points, training points, and fan base.


[h2]7. Player Value & Contracts[/h2]
 
 Players now understand they deserve salaries! Different players have different contract priorities. Some won’t allow you to list them without a high penalty fee. Some only care about signing bonuses, while others prefer short-term contracts, requiring a high price for long-term deals.


[h2]8. Building Match Venues[/h2]
   
Where will the salaries for your coaching team and players come from? You can charge fans for tickets!


[h2]9. Skipping Matches[/h2]
   
This doesn’t mean completely skipping matches. When you let the team play automatically, there might be situations needing your intervention.
  
 "Coach, we are leading with a 10:0 kill ratio. Should we press our advantage?"
 "Coach, we’re behind by 10k gold. Can you help us turn the tide?"


[h2]10. Event Editor[/h2]
    
This week, we will open the API, allowing mod creators to collaborate with us. We understand that programming requires time and isn’t a skill everyone has, so we will also provide an event editor that doesn’t require programming.


[h2]11. AI Overhaul[/h2]

We’ll offer more challenging card-playing AI and Ban & Pick AI. We hope our coaches won’t break a sweat.


[h2]12. More Equipment & Rhythm Rules & Gameplay Rules[/h2]


[h2]13.More Events and Interviews[/h2]

While allowing coaches to use the event editor to create more events, we will continue to develop additional events to meet the needs of coaches for breaks between matches.


[h3]Lastly, thank you once again, coaches! "Esports Godfather" couldn't have come this far without your support! Feel free to leave comments and engage in discussions in the community, or join our official Discord to discuss with us![/h3]


Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Wpf6y7kFjp


Twitter (X)  https://twitter.com/1000_Water_

notes.title: Esports Godfather limited-time demo for Next Fest is released!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This is the Asteroid Game Studio!


We appreciate your long-standing support for "Esports Godfather." 


[b]We are excited to announce the release of the limited-time demo for Steam NEXT FEST![/b]


We add lots of new contents into this demo, including the much-anticipated League 2 matches, customizable options during matches, and everything you are eagerly waiting for!


After last week's testing, we received valuable feedback. After working for a week, we not only fixed bugs but also successfully integrated the expected new content into this demo!


Now, let me introduce the updates in details:


[h3][b]1. Post-Match Evaluation:[/b][/h3]

Confusing why he's the MVP? Now, get all the answers! Check detailed performances after each match and comments from casters and viewers. Note that some commentators may have strange favor(Maybe some viewer will give 10/10 just because you picked Zealot XD)


[h3][b]2. League 2:[/b][/h3]

The Challenger Series is just the beginning. In this version, you can advance to the League 2 and play the first 8 matches. Comparing with those weak teams in Challenger Series, League 2 teams are stronger in attributes and AI. Hope players complaining about low difficulty can enjoy this.


[h3][b]3. New Ban-Pick Mechanism:[/b][/h3]

In the League 2, ban slots will be increased to 3, which makes BP phase more influential.  You can not defeat all with just one draft. And you need to prepare multiple drafts to face this new challenge. Of course, you can also gain a huge advantage by good BP strategy.


[h3][b]4. Equipment System:[/b][/h3]

MOBA without equipment? Not anymore! From the League 2, the equipment system will be introduced (We prepared over 50 pieces even in this demo!). Before each match, you can configure 3 pieces of equipment for each of your hero, pick right equipment for your heroes to unleash their formidable strength. For every version, there is a changing list of available equipment (About 20 pieces each version), so you need to find heroes those has the best synergies with the equipment.


[h3][b]5.Version Update System:[/b][/h3]

You think you have a invincible BOT athlete so you can win every game with 1-carry style? Sorry, it is very hard because version always changes (Actually, we think “only 1 strategy + repeat for tens of matches” mode is kind of boring XD)! For every month, there are minor changes in version rules. And for every season, version rules change a lot! You need to find version answer in various version rules.

In this demo, we prepare over 20 version rules. Hope you can enjoy a lot! (Of course, they cannot occur in the same version, if you want to experience as many as possible of them, you need to restart new game.)


[h3][b]6. More New Heroes:[/b][/h3]

9 new heroes join this game during League-2. More heroes bring more game experience and strategy! Besides, in order to facilitate changes in tactical arrangements for coaches during version updates, new routine affairs have been added to adjust athletes’ hero pool.


[h3][b]7. Customize Gameplay :[/b][/h3]

We mentioned before that we would gradually add some custom options for gameplay. Based on recent feedback, we've been working hard and have now introduced 2 custom options: the threshold for automatic recall to base when low on health and jungle routes for junglers. Now, players can freely customize the pace of their matches, making the game more aligned with their tactical expectations.

In the full-released version, we will introduce more custom option, hoping that every player can find their own comfort zone in the gaming experience.


[h3][b]8. Misc Changes And Eggs:[/b][/h3]

Besides the major updates, we've added many new things! Explore and discover these surprises in the game!

Finally, thanks for your long-term support of Asteroid game studio. Your feedback helps us make "Esports Godfather" better. We hope you'll continue to support us in this update! Keep playing, report bugs, and give suggestions! Thank you all!

notes.title: Beta testing for League 2 comes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been a while. I'm 1000water, the producer of "Esports Godfather." I wonder if you've had enough of 6 matches in Challenger Series?


Many of the suggestions you provided earlier have been very helpful to us, such that we need to explain why a hero is chosen as the MVP and using statistics like damage per round.


Now, we have completed the basic work on League 2, and we can't wait for everyone to try it and give us your feedback!
[PS: Since Challenger Series is a trial version, this League 2 is a test, so we will not update it to the Esports Godfather: Origin.]


You can download the beta version with the League 2 from the "Esports Godfather" page.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1278540/_/


[h2]Now, let me introduce what we have done in League 2：[/h2]


[h3]1. Version Update System[/h3]
No one likes a stagnant system, and I am no exception. In past games, balance has always been a focal point of discussion. We have been thinking about the value and significance of balance, and honestly, the reason we created Esports Godfather is because of this system, and now it will meet everyone for the first time!


At the beginning of each season, new major rules will change, affecting the timing and rewards of special teamfight (Dragon, Herald, Colossus), greatly impacting the game's pace!


As the season progresses, minor rules will be gradually revealed! Starting from the beginning of the season, every month, we will unlock a gameplay rule covering various aspects, such as adjusting all card costs, hand size limits, rules of jungle, and more. I believe this will be a challenge for everyone! A version change means a change in the hero ecosystem. You need to understand and try it out to come up with your answer!


[h3]2. Equipment System[/h3]
Starting from the League 2, the equipment system is about to be introduced! You can equip 3 pieces of equipment for heroes, and it will be unlocked when the gold reaches the requirement!


The classification of magical and physical heroes will also have significance. Physical heroes can only use physical and universal equipment, magic heroes can only use magical and universal equipment, and only hybrid heroes can use all equipment.


And each version, we will randomly select from the equipment pool. Will mages dominate, or will warriors rule, or perhaps only marksmen can hit the bullseye?


PS. The equipment system has only undergone the first phase of adjustments. We expect to carry out the second phase of adjustments next week. There may be some combinations that are too powerful, but don't worry; we will handle it as soon as possible.


[h3]3. League Mode[/h3]
The Challenger Series is just the birthplace of legends, but by no means the end of legends!


Starting from the League 2, your team will face the challenges of the league. Each league has 13 teams(including you, of course), and 5 of them will be eliminated in the regular, leaving only the top 8 outstanding teams to participate in the playoffs!


You not only need to consider the issue of points but also prepare more tactics. This will be an extra challenge! The League 2 will adopt a 3-BAN system, in other words, each team can ban 3 heroes! The game of victory or defeat begins with the ban-pick phase!


[h3]4. New Heroes[/h3]
In the upcoming version, we will release some new heroes for everyone to play.


When new heroes are unlocked, if your team members are interested, you can directly include these new heroes in their hero pool!

PS. Unlocked with each version change as the game progresses.


In addition to the above, we have added some small “toys”, such as replacing players when promoted to the League 2.


Today's update has opened eight matches in the regular season of the League 2. Now, the trial version can play a total of 14 (6+8) matches. I hope everyone enjoys it.


The current version has some systems that are not yet open, so the values of other clubs may seem a bit high. We will try to get everything done by next week.


[h2]Our update plan for next week is as follows:[/h2]


[h3]【Implementation of Training Matches】[/h3]
Players no longer need to practice heroes in matches! Based on the difference in attributes between players, numerical improvements can be obtained, and players will also increase their proficiency with the heroes they use. If the opponent's player uses a hero included in our player's hero pool, it will also increase proficiency!


[h3]【 Implementation of Sponsors】[/h3]
If your performance is outstanding, sponsors will want to help you! When signing, you can get training points, coach points, and monthly goals!


[h3]【Optimization】[/h3]
Nothing is more headache-inducing than optimization. We expect to address some long-standing optimization issues next week!


Actually, we are also thinking about issues related to the creative workshop. In our plan, Esports Godfather will open the creative workshop, but we may need some help. If there are friends who hope to develop Esports Godfather-related mods and have mod development experience, it would be even better. 


We would like to know what kind of interface you would prefer and what kind of support would be more suitable for you! Feel free to contact us at any time.


"E-sports Godfather"
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Wpf6y7kFjp

Twitter (X)  https://twitter.com/1000_Water_


Finally, we have confirmed our participation in the Next Fest in Feb.! So, this test will continue until the end of the Next Fest! And the Chinese New Year is coming subsequently! So, we expect the League 2 test to be open until February 18th, until the end of Chinese New Year!
Hope everyone has fun playing during this period!


Happy Chinese New Year!
